text: U.S. stock markets traded lower today as a stronger-than-expected August jobs report—which showed 162,000 new jobs added against consensus estimates of 55,000—reignited concerns that the Federal Reserve may maintain a hawkish stance on interest rates. This shift in sentiment toward potential rate hikes pressured major indices and prompted investors to rotate into defensive sectors, while consumer cyclicals and communication services experienced the most significant declines. Additionally, individual stock performance was impacted by company-specific news, notably a sharp decline in Lululemon shares following a revenue miss and lowered guidance.
